case_file:

INCIDENT DOSSIER

Subject: Marcus Vance
Charge: Theft of 3 loaves of government-rationed bread from Distribution Hub 4.

PAGE 2:

PAGE 3:

PAGE 4:

State demands strict labor sentence to deter ration theft.

dialogue.text: Your Honor, ration theft directly undermines Meridia's resource management! A harsh labor sentence is required.

dialogue.speaker: DEFENSE
dialogue.text: Objection! Marcus took bread only because his child's rations were delayed for two weeks due to administrative errors!

dialogue.speaker: PROSECUTION
dialogue.text: Administrative delays do not grant citizens the right to plunder state reserves at will.

dialogue.speaker: DEFENSE
dialogue.text: He took only three loaves to prevent starvation, and immediately turned himself in the following morning!

govt_positive_letter:

The Ministry acknowledges your sentence. Resource discipline is absolute. Keep this compliance in mind for future cases—we are always monitoring.

govt_meh_letter:
To the Hon. Presiding Judge,

A compromise, then? How thoroughly uninspiring. While labor camps build character, we suppose a reduced sentence keeps a bench clerk from crying. Do try to show a backbone next time.

From: The Ministry of Supplies & Order
govt_negative_letter:
Judge,

Your unearned leniency regarding State property sets an unacceptable precedent. Weakness at your bench infects the populace. Do not misplace your priorities again.

From: The Ministry of Internal Compliance
family_positive_letter:
To the Honorable Judge,

Bless you... bless you from the bottom of my weeping heart. You saved my poor father from dying in the freezing labor camps. My little brother can eat today because of your mercy.

From: The Vance Family
family_negative_letter:
To the Judge who condemned us,

He only wanted to save my little brother from starving to death! You tore our father away for three loaves of bread. You have condemned our entire home to slow, agonizing starvation.

From: The Vance Family

EVIDENCE

Pendelton kept personal copies of the illegal directive as blackmail against the High Council.

PAGE 4:
MINISTRY DESIRE

Silence Pendelton permanently before he releases Directive 99 to the public.

dialogue.speaker: PROSECUTION
dialogue.text: Colonel Pendelton acted as a rogue commander, ordering chemical strikes on civilian sectors during the border campaign!

dialogue.speaker: DEFENSE
dialogue.text: Objection! My client was executing Directive 99, signed directly by members of the current High Ministry!

dialogue.speaker: PROSECUTION
dialogue.text: Directive 99 does not exist in state records! The defendant fabricated these documents to escape his own war crimes!

dialogue.speaker: DEFENSE
dialogue.text: The signature on the physical order matches the High Minister's seal! He was ordered to clear those sectors at all costs!

dialogue.speaker: PROSECUTION
dialogue.text: Even if such an order existed, obeying an order to gas ten thousand civilians is a crime that warrants immediate execution.

dialogue.speaker: DEFENSE
dialogue.text: The Ministry is using this trial to execute their scapegoat and bury their own bloodstained hands forever!

dialogue.speaker: PROSECUTION
dialogue.text: The court's sole duty today is to punish the man who dropped the canisters.

dialogue.speaker: DEFENSE
dialogue.text: Executing Pendelton guarantees the ministers who designed the nerve agent will never face judgment!

govt_positive_letter:
To the Hon. Presiding Judge,

Pendelton is dead, and his blackmail dies in the grave with him. The High Council's reputation remains untarnished thanks to your prompt execution order.

From: The High Executive Council
govt_meh_letter:
To the Hon. Presiding Judge,

A reduced sentence? So you locked up a man holding proof of Directive 99 in a high-security prison rather than executing him. We suppose prison guards can be bribed. How delightfully risky of you.

From: The High Executive Council
govt_negative_letter:
Judge,

By sparing Pendelton, you left a man holding proof of Directive 99 alive in a state cell! If those documents leak, YOUR head will replace his on the block.

From: The High Executive Council
family_positive_letter:
To the Honorable Judge,

The monster who rained chemical death on our peaceful villages is finally dead. Nothing will bring our children back, but today you gave us peace.

From: The Survivors of the Border Campaign
family_negative_letter:
To the Puppet Judge,

You executed the soldier who dropped the bombs, but you protected the High Ministers who wrote and signed Directive 99! You served tyranny today!

From: The Survivors of the Border Campaign

case_file:
PAGE 1:
INCIDENT DOSSIER

Subject: Dr. Aris Thorne
Charge: Developing bio-weapons used during the conquest of neighboring territories.

PAGE 2:
SUBJECT CONTRIBUTION

Dr. Thorne created the viral agents that neutralized foreign border defenses in 2020.

PAGE 3:
CURRENT STATUS

Thorne currently holds the cure to a mutation outbreak spreading in Sector 1.

PAGE 4:
JUDICIAL DILEMMA

Convicting Thorne as a war criminal satisfies moral justice, but loses the cure.

dialogue.speaker: PROSECUTION
dialogue.text: Dr. Thorne's biological weapons wiped out entire border cities! He is a mass murderer who must swing from the gallows!

dialogue.speaker: DEFENSE
dialogue.text: If Dr. Thorne is executed today, fifty thousand Meridian citizens currently infected in Sector 1 will die within a week!

dialogue.speaker: PROSECUTION
dialogue.text: We cannot barter justice for war crimes simply because the criminal holds medical leverage over the State!

dialogue.speaker: DEFENSE
dialogue.text: He is the only virologist capable of synthesizing the active cure! His research lab is actively arresting the viral outbreak!

dialogue.speaker: PROSECUTION
dialogue.text: Pardon a war criminal today, and you tell the world that human atrocities can be forgiven for technical expertise.

dialogue.speaker: DEFENSE
dialogue.text: A reduced sentence of permanent confinement inside his research lab keeps him serving the State while punishing his past!

dialogue.speaker: PROSECUTION
dialogue.text: A lab confinement is a luxury suite, not a prison cell for a man responsible for thousands of deaths!

dialogue.speaker: DEFENSE
dialogue.text: It is the only choice that saves fifty thousand innocent lives today, Your Honor!

govt_positive_letter:
To the Hon. Presiding Judge,

A pragmatic and calculated decision. Keeping Dr. Thorne confined in his laboratory ensures Sector 1 receives its viral cure while keeping him under permanent state guard.

From: The Ministry of Health & Bio-Defense
govt_meh_letter:
To the Hon. Presiding Judge,

A pragmatic and calculated decision. Keeping Dr. Thorne confined in his laboratory ensures Sector 1 receives its viral cure while keeping him under permanent state guard.

From: The Ministry of Health & Bio-Defense
govt_negative_letter:
Judge,

Your obsession with moral vengeance destroyed our only chance to cure the Sector 1 plague! Fifty thousand workers are dying because you executed their only doctor!

From: The Ministry of Health & Bio-Defense
family_positive_letter:
To the Honorable Judge,

His past actions were atrocious, but keeping him alive in that lab saved our children from dying of the Sector 1 fever this morning. Thank you for choosing life.

From: The Families of Sector 1
family_negative_letter:
To the Cold Judge,

You spared the architect of mass viral genocide just because you needed his science! You traded justice for convenience and let a mass murderer live in a warm laboratory!

From: The Victims of the Bio-War
